info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Report Retrieval API
info.description: The Customer Report Retrieval API allows users to access detailed reports associated with specific customers. By providing a unique customer ID and report ID, users can retrieve important insights and analytics relevant to their decision-making processes. This API is particularly useful for analysts and decision-makers seeking to understand customer behaviors, trends, and performance metrics. It streamlines the process of report access, ensuring that stakeholders have the necessary information at their fingertips.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific report for a customer.
get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch detailed reports associated with a specific customer, identified by their unique customer ID, along with the unique report ID. It provides insights into customer activities and metrics that are vital for analysis.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the report associated with the specified customer and report IDs. It contains parameters necessary for the operation and should be formatted as JSON.

GetCustomerReportCUST100045RES100045Requ.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on the report resource related to customer CUST-100045.
